```file:test_calc.py
import unittest
from calc import evaluate, ExpressionError

class TestEvaluate(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_single_number(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("42"), 42.0)

    def test_addition(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("2 + 3"), 5.0)

    def test_multiplication(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("2 * 3"), 6.0)

    def test_precedence(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("2 + 3 * 4"), 14.0)

    def test_parentheses(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("(1 + 2) * 3"), 9.0)

    def test_unary_minus(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("-5"), -5.0)

    def test_complex_expression(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("(1 + 2.5) * -3"), -10.5)

    def test_division(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate("10 / 4"), 2.5)

    def test_empty_expression(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ExpressionError):
            evaluate("")

    def test_unbalanced_parentheses(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ExpressionError):
            evaluate("(1 + 2")

    def test_division_by_zero(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ExpressionError):
            evaluate("1 / 0")

    def test_invalid_character(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ExpressionError):
            evaluate("2 @ 3")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
